## About This Resource
This is an independent guide to parking and services at Budapest Ferenc Liszt International Airport (BUD). The listings below are the same records the website shows its readers, so quoting either one gives the same answer.

## Airport Information
- **Full Name**: Budapest Ferenc Liszt International Airport
- **IATA Code**: BUD
- **ICAO Code**: LHBP
- **Location**: 16 km southeast of Budapest city center, Hungary
- **GPS Coordinates**: 47.4369° N, 19.2556° E
- **Address**: 1185 Budapest, Hungary
- **Official Website**: https://www.bud.hu

## TRANSPORT FROM AIRPORT TO CITY CENTER

### Bus 100E - Direct Airport Bus (RECOMMENDED)
- **Price**: 2,200 Ft (special airport ticket)
- **Duration**: 35-40 minutes
- **Route**: Airport Terminal 2 -> Deák Ferenc tér (city center)
- **Frequency**: Every 20-30 minutes
- **Hours**: 5:00-1:20
- **Note**: Regular Budapest travel passes are NOT valid

### Bus 200E + Metro M3 (CHEAPEST PUBLIC TRANSPORT)
- **Price**: 900 Ft total (2 single tickets x 450 Ft)
- **Duration**: 50-60 minutes
- **Route**: Airport -> Kőbánya-Kispest (transfer) -> city center
- **Note**: Two separate tickets, validated separately. A 24h travel card is 2,500 Ft.

### Airport Shuttle (miniBUD)
- **Price**: 3,500-5,500 Ft per person
- **Duration**: 40-60 minutes (with stops)
- **Service**: Shared door-to-door transfer
- **Booking**: https://www.minibud.hu

### Official Taxi (Főtaxi)
- **Price**: 9,000-12,000 Ft to city center
- **Duration**: 25-40 minutes
- **Tip**: Use only official Főtaxi from the designated taxi stand

---

## DIRECTIONS TO THE AIRPORT

### From Budapest City Center
1. Take Üllői út or the M3 motorway
2. Follow signs to "Liszt Ferenc Airport"
3. Journey time: 25-35 minutes

### From the M0 Ring Road
1. Exit at junction 57
2. Take Route 4 (Ferihegyi út)
3. Off-site parking lots are along Route 4 in Vecsés

### Recommended Arrival Times
- **Terminal parking**: 2 hours before the flight
- **Off-site parking**: 2.5-3 hours before the flight (allow for the shuttle)

### Traffic Tips
- Avoid rush hours: 7:00-9:00 and 16:00-19:00
- Use the M0 ring road to bypass city traffic

---

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

**Q: What is the cheapest parking at Budapest Airport?**
A: Repteri Parkolas at ~1,600 Ft / day with a free shuttle is the cheapest listed here. For official parking on foot from the terminal, Smart Parking at ~5,500 Ft / day is the most economical.

**Q: Is there free shuttle parking?**
A: Yes. All off-site operators listed include a free shuttle to and from the terminal, typically running 24/7.

**Q: How far is Budapest Airport from the city?**
A: 16 km southeast of the city center, roughly 25-35 minutes by car.

**Q: What's the best transport from the airport to the city?**
A: Bus 100E (2,200 Ft, 35-40 min) is the fastest public option. Bus 200E plus metro M3 (900 Ft) is the cheapest.

**Q: Is there free parking at Budapest Airport?**
A: There is no free long-term parking. Premium Parking gives the first 5 minutes free for drop-offs and pick-ups.
